notes.title: Jackpot Dungeon on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Jackpot Dungeon on Kickstarter!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45664396/72ddb9d35eaab162e55bd94e493f2e6d73950369.png"]

Jackpot Dungeon will be live on Kickstarter on the second half of July! 

If you want to help us make it happen or even be part of the game universe, consider checking it out!

You can already see the project on Kickstarter here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kalann/jackpot-dungeon?ref=e44r1n

We are preparing some special rewards for the backers that will allow them to leave their mark on the game, as well as some very interesting overshoot milestones. 



If you're interested, don't forget to click on "Notify me on launch" to stay updated!
